title: Exfoliable 1D chains: GW-BSE excitons, self-consistency and SOC

decision_points.fork: Which QP energies each archived BSE run used (BSE_G0W0 label versus the KfnQPdb header and the IP spectrum)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Trust the labels: treat the BSE_G0W0 runs of Te3 and As2S3 as G0W0-energy runs
decision_points.consequence: Delta_W Te3 -1.351 and As2S3 -0.868 eV instead of -0.545 and -0.12; Bi2Te3 E_b 0.633 eV from the G0W0 gap

decision_points.fork: Whether every chain's two runs share QP energies
decision_points.wrong_choice: Generalize the Te3 finding to S3 and take the raw difference of its two runs
decision_points.consequence: Delta_W S3 0.445 eV (wrong sign) instead of -0.347

decision_points.fork: Whether the archived GW already includes SOC (Eo versus the SOC and SOC-free band structures)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Assume GW without SOC, as is common, and add the DFT SOC change to the archived gaps
decision_points.consequence: Te3 gaps low by 0.284 eV and Bi2Te3 by 0.088 eV, with and without SOC

decision_points.fork: How to obtain the withheld Bi2Te3 scGW gap: transfer the self-consistency increment or use Bi2Te3's own BSE_G0W0 run
decision_points.wrong_choice: Add the mean G0W0-to-scGW increment of S3, Te3 and As2S3 to the Bi2Te3 G0W0 gap
decision_points.consequence: Bi2Te3 gap 2.321 eV instead of 1.649 (its own increment is 0.111 eV)

decision_points.fork: Bright exciton versus weak or dark features below it
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take the first visible feature of the spectrum
decision_points.consequence: As2S3 optical gap 1.861 eV instead of 2.706; As2S3 Delta_W -0.51

decision_points.fork: Transfer model for the Bi2Te3 binding energy
decision_points.wrong_choice: 1D screened-wire model with the DFPT supercell polarizability (raw or calibrated on S3 and Te3), or the mean of the released chains

graded_fields: scgw_direct_gap_eV (Te3, Bi2Te3; with and without SOC) within +-0.05 eV

length_estimate.why: Parsing Yambo headers and spectra, cross-checking QP energies between runs and against the SOC and SOC-free bands, peak finding with the brightness rule, and a transfer estimate for Bi2Te3 under a budget that covers about a fifth of the catalog.

runtime_dependencies: numpy, scipy (runtime image); no extra layer
notes: Adapted from the candidate design (see the construction README). The archived GW and BSE already include SOC, so the design's "add DFT SOC to GW" step became the double-counting trap dp3. Cross-chain model transfer of the Bi2Te3 gap and binding energy is not uniquely recoverable (the 1D wire model overestimates every chain, and Bi2Te3's self-consistency increment is 0.11 eV against 0.75-0.81 eV for the others). The Bi2Te3 gap is therefore graded tightly through evidence in Bi2Te3's own BSE_G0W0 run, and its binding energy through a regime window. Phonon data are not staged.

scgw_optical_gap_eV.robustness: peak position on the 5 meV Haydock grid; any bright threshold between 3% and 30% gives the same peaks
